name: Notes
description: Choose your notes folder, prepare note changes for approval, and search your indexed notes.

settings.label: Notes folder
settings.description: Browse, link, change or unlink your allowed notes folder. View saved sync status. Manual and scheduled sync and write chat tools are not available yet.

features.description: The Notes package provides the managed-source account-export section through its public API. It includes saved source status, destination labels, contributions, proposals and operation receipts visible to the calling account. The account export screen is not joined yet; chat tools and sync are unfinished. Notes has no standalone screen or navigation entry.

errors.description: The host could not complete the export. No partial export is returned.

remediations.description: Retry the account export after the host service is available.

features.description: Settings → Connections shows the linked folder and its saved last-sync status. Browse allowed folders, enter a path, change the link, or confirm unlinking without deleting files. Saved status may be from an earlier installation; this package does not run manual or scheduled sync or write chat tools. It is not a replacement for legacy Notes. The host must connect the folder settings adapter with account-specific allowed roots. Symlink selections are refused by the current vault adapter.

errors.description: The entered folder is outside the allowed roots, missing or unreadable. The chooser keeps the entered path so it can be corrected.
The configured folder roots are missing or unavailable.
The linked folder could not be checked, or a save had an uncertain result. Writes stay disabled until it is checked again.

remediations.description: Correct the path or browse an allowed folder, then link it again.
Ask the host administrator to configure allowed folders for your account.
Check the connection and use Try again before changing the folder.

features.description: The prepareNoteAction public API prepares legacy create, edit and delete approval details from the calling account's linked folder. It returns the target, ordered fields and current version, including the permanent-delete warning. Preparing details does not grant approval, change files or request sync. Installed chat execution and approval consumption remain unfinished. Canonical source identity is used for versions; symlink descendant selections remain refused.

errors.description: The source is unlinked, missing or outside allowed roots. No action details are returned.
The source or file could not be checked. No action is approved or run.

remediations.description: Link an available notes folder within the allowed roots. Ask the administrator to configure roots if none are available.
Check the connection and prepare the action again before approving it.

features.description: The host provides core-owned Notes file ingestion (folder walk, legacy document chunking, configured document embeddings, unchanged-file skipping and per-page atomic indexing) behind the sync coordinator's vault ports, plus atomic deleted-note cleanup. Assembly must connect MemoryIngestPorts and MemoryCleanupPorts with the same account-specific roots and notes-source-path preference as folder settings, and supply the account's configured document embedding model. Managed publication snapshots are refused until that join exists. The ordinary package still declares no sync job, schedule, manual sync route or write chat tools, so scheduled and manual sync are not available in the app yet.

remediations.description: Ask the host administrator to connect core memory ingestion and the configured document embedding service, and link an allowed notes folder.

features.description: The read-only notes.search tool returns your existing indexed Notes chunks in semantic order, with source paths and line ranges. The host must connect core memory and your configured query embedding service. Sync and automatic chat recall are not implemented yet; file changes are not indexed by this checkpoint. Chat integration must first preserve the legacy schemas and outside-content classification; note text is untrusted data.

errors.description: The memory search adapter or query embedding service is unavailable.

remediations.description: Ask the host administrator to connect core memory search and the configured query embedding service.

features.description: The durable sync test worker records final counts or a safe failure in the calling account's saved last-sync status after database finalization. Deferred pages and ticks after unlinking preserve prior results. Status writes are best effort and never change the sync result. Assembly must wrap the transaction and queue adapters with FolderSyncStatusPorts, bound to notes-last-sync. Manual and scheduled sync are not available in the ordinary package yet.

Owner-only durable sync checkpoints keep continuation paths and hashes out of queued job parameters. The write-tools test component can request and resume sync by checkpoint ID. Create, edit and delete use the same durable request path after file mutation; checkpoint refusal before finalization compensates files, while publication refusal after commit leaves the file and checkpoint available for retry. Successful pages save a result under a transaction row lock; retries return that result and republish the same continuation ID without repeating ingestion. Final and no-op replays keep newer status; failed deferred publication can record a new safe failure. The test-only recoverNotesSync API scans private checkpoints in pages of at most twenty-five rows and requests publication of unfinished IDs without caller-selected accounts or paths. Completed pages are skipped; retries reuse their queue identities. A trusted server timer must follow each cursor only after successful finalization and periodically restart the scan to notice new requests. This is explicit recovery, not an active timer or retry of exhausted queue jobs. The ordinary package still offers no sync job, schedule or manual sync route. Transactional worker assembly with reserved ingestion connection capacity, checkpoint retention and automatic recovery timer assembly remain activation blockers.

notes.search.description: Search your indexed notes by meaning. Returns source paths, line ranges and text. New file changes need sync, which is not available in this checkpoint.
